report.summary: Patient P-D009 (Eileen Costigan, age 73, Medicare Advantage Lakeshore Senior PPO, home tract 17031720500) was seen today (visit V-D009). CMS AHC screener (2026-10-19) answered transportation need as "no" current barrier, and the tract has strong transit coverage (26 stops within 800m, early-morning service at all 26, <1% no-vehicle households). Still, transport options were identified for medical-appointment travel. Eligibility check: patient is NOT on Medicaid (Medicare Advantage only) so Medicaid Ride Line is not applicable; patient has no kidney condition so Kidney Care Rides is not applicable; patient is 73, which meets the age 60+ criterion for Senior Shuttle West (free rides to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM); ADA paratransit is available via certification (up to 21-day decision). Medicare Advantage transport benefit is listed as unknown — verify with the plan.
